verdict.rationale: SerpApi is a search-results API, so meaning-based semantic search is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows it scraping and parsing results from existing engines (Google, Bing, etc.) using their normal query syntax. Scraping Google AI Mode or AI Overview is a different feature that relays another engine's output; it is not SerpApi's own semantic retrieval, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run meaning-based semantic search that finds results keyword engines miss
